verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's own docs affirmatively claim support for product variations, including that customers can "choose from endless product variations," and variation galleries are now on by default, so the variant part of the story is covered. Nothing in the pack affirmatively documents custom fields or metafields, and attributes appear only in a planning question, which does not count as evidence of capability. missing for 10: documented custom fields/metafields support, affirmative documentation of attributes/options modeling beyond variations, in-depth variant configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a merchant, I can model products with variants, options, and custom fields/metafields that fit my catalog, not a fixed template

citations.quote: you can sell anything with Woo. Let customers choose from endless product variations, subscription options, single items, or bundles
WooCommerce 11.1 is here! Variation galleries now on for every store
